When prior project context may help an investigation, decision or handoff, follow [the Brain Bridge skill](../../skills/brain-bridge/SKILL.md). Use the configured named-source synapse interface and cite actual returned evidence. Missing configuration or denied access is not permission to use a filesystem fallback. This pointer grants no access and authorizes no mutations.

Every owner-authorized implementation commit must trigger a Brain Dump under the selected publishing flow; record its exact SHA and results. Brain-record-only publication commits satisfy the dump without recursively creating another. Follow the post-commit section of the Brain Bridge skill; preserve stable originals and report real queue/authorization failures instead of silently skipping a checkpoint. This does not grant a destination or write permission by itself.
